findings.finding: Mana Pool probe is based on original export language and has not been rebuilt against canonical Phyrexian normalization. Its 699 sale-covered rows and 436 capped rows describe the original probe only.
findings.next_action: Reconcile retained catalog against canonical variants; preserve up-to-20 sample semantics, cents, quantity, overlap and unknown completeness. Never sum repeated snapshots into full velocity.

findings.finding: Historical summaries reconcile arithmetically but include unavailable bids, incomplete modeled net and mixed valuation measures. Seven rows lack dealer values and 22 lack modeled net; aggregate sums conceal the missingness as zero contribution.
findings.next_action: Keep old summaries/recommendations historical. New outputs must expose coverage and use order-level net, actual bid capacity and comparable exact products.

findings.finding: No per-lot locations are populated. General binder/drawer/sleeve conventions and fulfillment preferences survive in the handoff memo, not structured operational records.
findings.next_action: Carry useful contextual statements with handoff provenance; obtain lot-specific locations only when needed, never infer them from current price.

findings.finding: Domri Rade Emblem TRVR #20 foil has no scan reference price. Its inventory identity and copy remain present.
findings.next_action: Keep missing reference null. Hydrate a suitable market observation if it matters; never invent purchase cost.

findings.finding: Original assets are retained and hash-verified; newer research files are outside the database registry. Database backups alone do not include filesystem-only source bytes.
findings.next_action: Include source files/capture manifests in the recovery plan. Registration is distinct from accepting a capture as current evidence.

findings.finding: Legacy flags and manual interpretations retain old labels, including foreign-language/finish review. They are not a current physical-uncertainty queue.
findings.next_action: Use current assertions and provider-mapping status; do not present retired audit flags as renewed owner questions.
